summary: Frontend-only regression + new ExecutiveAvatar feature test. All 6 demo avatars + homepage hero avatar render correctly with proper testids, controls, posters, lazy-loaded videos, and chip text. All 5 static avatar assets serve 200. Fullscreen briefing modal opens and closes via close-button, backdrop, and Escape. Mobile viewport correctly switches data-platform to 'mobile'. Koollite Dual-Path regression (iter 46) still passes.
critical_code_review_comments: ExecutiveAvatar.jsx (~419 lines) is well-structured but borderline on the 700-line guideline if more variants are added — consider splitting FullscreenBriefing and AvatarAnnouncementStrip into their own files for the next iteration.

FullscreenBriefing has parent <div onClick={onClose}> AND child close button onClick={onClose}. Click bubbles from button → backdrop, calling onClose twice. Harmless (idempotent setState) but consider e.stopPropagation() on the close button for cleanliness.
Demo pages share an identical Start→prefetchAll→setStarted(true) pattern. Could be extracted to a useCinematicDemo() hook for DRY.

useInView fallback (no IntersectionObserver) sets inView=true immediately — good. Consider also forcing inView=true above-the-fold when prefers-reduced-motion is set, so users get a static poster only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ExecutiveAvatar testids confirmed working: home-hero-avatar (+ -video, -play-toggle, -mute-toggle, -fullscreen), executive-avatar-briefing (+ -close), supermarket-demo-avatar, airport-demo-avatar, school-demo-avatar, noldus-demo-avatar, realtor-demo-avatar, startup-demo-avatar. data-platform attribute switches between 'desktop' and 'mobile' on ≤768px. Hero loop video uses /avatars/avatar-hero-loop.mp4 (1.9MB no audio). Demo variants use desktop-opt or mobile-opt depending on viewport. IMPORTANT: cinematic demos (airport, supermarket, noldus, realtor) require clicking Start Demo and waiting 5–10s for prefetchAll() to resolve before the avatar mounts — initial test failed at 3s wait but passed at 10s+. School and Startup demos render the avatar immediately on page load. Koollite Dual-Path regression checks (home-koollite-dual-path-section, koollite-roi-page, lighting-dual-path-section) still pass.
rca of the issue: No app bugs found. One Playwright test artifact: force=True click on the briefing close button + 400ms wait read the modal as still mounted — but a direct DOM `.click()` confirmed the close handler fires synchronously and the modal unmounts. Treated as a test-timing issue, not a real bug. Noldus avatar was initially flagged FAIL because handleStart awaits prefetchAll() before flipping setStarted(true); test originally waited only 3s. Re-test with up to 90s wait passed in ~5s — feature is correct, the test was too aggressive.
